items.title: Shanto urges Tigers to keep the grind going
items.summary: The Tigers know a sterner test awaits in Mackay, where conditions are expected to offer more assistance to Australia.

items.title: Confident Shanto plots 'five days of good cricket again'
items.summary: Bangladesh captain Najmul Hossain Shanto believes his side can cope with the extra bounce in Mackay, the venue of the second Test against Australia

items.title: Lyon survives selection call as Renshaw locked in to open
items.summary: Jake Weatherald, who had opened with Travis Head in the first Test against Bangladesh, was dropped from the squad prior to the second Test, which starts on Saturday in Mackay

items.title: Tanzid ‘positive’, Shoriful ‘ready’ as Tigers ponder XI for Mackay Test
items.summary: Bangladesh have five pace bowlers available for the Test, but Shanto said the final combination would only be decided after another inspection of the Mackay surface on Saturday morning.

items.title: Bangladesh eye more history with only one result on Australia's mind
items.summary: Bangladesh did the unthinkable in Darwin, and will have to do it all over again if they want to convert the Test match win to a Test series win

items.title: Renshaw only change; Australia name XI shortly after Cummins’ call for time
items.summary: Matthew Renshaw was the only change, replacing Jake Weatherald at the top of the order, while Lyon retained his place for the second Test against Bangladesh at the Great Barrier Reef Arena in Mackay.

items.title: Shanto blocks out history, focuses on next five days
items.summary: The approach is also about putting the emotion of their historic nine-wicket victory in Darwin behind them.

items.title: More history beckons Tigers against wounded Australia
items.summary: The Mackay pitch is likely to offer more pace and bounce, potentially giving Australia’s fast bowlers a much stronger platform. The open nature of the venue could also bring strong winds into play, adding another challenge for Bangladesh’s batters.

items.title: India's tour of Bangladesh could be postponed yet again
items.summary: The tour was originally planned for August last year before being deferred to September 2026

items.title: 'Australia are going to come harder at us' - Simmons to high-flying Bangladesh
items.summary: Head coach wants his side to start second Test against Australia "on the right footing" after the highs of Darwin

items.title: Renshaw 'has got the game for all conditions' as he returns to Test cricket
items.summary: Matt Renshaw has returned to Australia's Test squad for the second Test against Bangladesh and is in line to play a Test after three-and-a-half years

items.title: Weatherald dropped, Renshaw called up for second Test against Bangladesh
items.summary: The opener has paid the price for Australia's poor display in Darwin and is the only change made to the squad

items.title: Bangladesh trump Australia for historic win in Darwin after Mehidy five-for
items.summary: Visitors needed just 57 to win on day four even as Cameron Green scored 104 for Australia in the second innings

items.title: Time for change? Who are Australia's batting options?
items.summary: The result of the first Test against Bangladesh could demand a reaction from the selectors

items.title: Shanto: Whole team deserves Player-of-the-Match award
items.summary: Bangladesh captain hails his fast bowlers for dismissing Australia for 198 on the opening day in Darwin

items.title: Shanto: 'Biggest win for Bangladesh in any format'
items.summary: Shanto especially heaped praise on his fast bowlers, who took all 10 wickets in the first innings

items.title: Bangladesh chip away to keep famous victory in sight
items.summary: Hasan Mahmud claimed both Australia's openers while Mehidy Hasan Miraz followed a half-century with the key wicket of Steven Smith
